title_candidates: ChatGPT Health can now connect records and Apple Health
summary: ChatGPT Health is rolling out to U.S. adults with optional medical-record and Apple Health connections, separate permissions, and important privacy limits.

primary_source.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: Health is gradually rolling out to U.S. ChatGPT users age 18 and older on web and iOS.
Eligible plans are Free, Go, Plus, and Pro.
Users can connect Apple Health, supported medical records, One Medical, and Function Health.
Connected data and conversations that use it are not used for model training or ad targeting.
Disconnecting a source does not remove health details already included in chat history.
OpenAI says ChatGPT can make mistakes and does not replace medical professionals.

supporting_sources.title: Health in ChatGPT
key_facts: Official eligibility, setup, permission, deletion, and troubleshooting details.

supporting_sources.title: Health Privacy Notice
key_facts: Official health-data privacy terms and user controls.

prerequisites: A U.S. ChatGPT account for someone age 18 or older

steps.instruction: Check the sidebar or More menu for Health.
Read permissions before connecting a source.
Test a non-urgent appointment-preparation question without connecting data.
Verify details and review account and chat-history deletion controls separately.

risk_flags: Health is a gradual U.S.-only rollout and is not a diagnosis or treatment service.
